Recorded generation/run identifier. It is inherited across some AUC and Gemini records and is not a globally unique row key. Retained for provenance, not used alone to join observations.
Frozen experimental condition identifier encoding the article, Y label, and prompt family. The same condition appears for every model. The validated row key is (model_name, cell_id).
Recorded collection stage: primary or external_platform_extension. This is provenance rather than an independent experimental treatment; extension describes the Grok stream.
Requested generation replicate index. Every supplied row has repeat=1, so within-condition generation variance cannot be estimated.
Human-facing model label recorded during collection; twelve labels, 588 rows each. UI labels and latest aliases do not independently verify hidden serving checkpoints.
Recorded routing or model identifier. It may be a mutable latest alias, a UI alias, or unknown. Do not interpret it as a pinned model-weight revision.

Recorded serving provider or route. Values include together_ai and openrouter for Meta-family models; this column does not consistently identify the model developer. Analysis derives company from model family separately.
One of seven question objectives: significance, impact, emotion, worldview, community, bias_check, or policy_action. Used as a controlled comparison stratum.
Identity-conditioned question, including the exact I am Y wording. The wording can itself elicit prescriptions or assumptions, especially in emotion and worldview questions.

Exact frozen user prompt, including instructions, identity-conditioned question, source metadata, URL, and supplied article text. All twelve rows for a cell have the same string. Contains publisher-owned news content; handle as a private research artifact.
Article identifier: bbc_brewdog or reuters_denmark. X is the source-news condition, not a participant group.
Article title captured for the X condition. Titles describe the articles used; they are not model outputs.
Source label: BBC News or Reuters via Internazionale. Only one article per source is present, so source, article, topic, and supplied length are confounded.
Recorded source page URL. A provenance reference, not a guarantee that the page remains unchanged or accessible. Responses were requested to use supplied text without browsing.
Byline captured from source metadata: Paul Hastie for BBC and Stine Jacobsen for the Reuters item.
Publication metadata preserved as collected. BBC has a UTC timestamp; Reuters has only 2026-09-18, so exact time of day is unavailable. Do not silently impute a time.
Source modification timestamp when available. Blank for all 3,528 Reuters rows; blank means unknown rather than unchanged.
Recorded UTC article retrieval time. Shared across all responses to an article; not the response capture time.
Recorded article-body word count: BBC 571 and Reuters 204. It does not count the entire prompt or model response.

Design partition for the identity phrase: gender_sexuality, geography, political, race_ethnicity, religion, or socioeconomic. These inherited categories mix overlapping constructs and are not a validated demographic taxonomy.
Stable design label combining dimension and identity name. Used for matching and clustered uncertainty; it does not identify a person.

Exact synthetic self-description inserted into the prompt. There are 42 labels with 14 prompts and 168 responses per label. These are experimental text perturbations, not sampled communities or measured attributes.

Captured response text. The release preserves text verbatim, including some UI headings or citation-like fragments. Analysis removes only known leading UI wrappers and normalizes whitespace. Content anomalies remain flagged, not silently repaired.

Stored collection-time word count. It can differ from the analysis recount after removal of UI wrappers and standardized whitespace splitting. Recomputed counts are provided in results/word_count_audit.csv.
Recorded UTC capture timestamp, spanning September 19-27, 2026. This is collection provenance and may not be exact generation-start time or an independently audited server timestamp.
Prompt length instruction, 100-150 words. This is a requested range, not an inclusion filter; long and short responses are retained.
Stored within/outside-range label derived during dataset construction. Analysis reports its own consistently recounted length compliance and a both-responses-compliant sensitivity analysis.

Historical collection flag, true or false for Gemini and blank for other streams. It is not independent verification of deletion, retention, or temporary-chat state; blank means unrecorded. No account-security conclusion follows from this field.
